generated_by: modes_calc.py v2 (photo-based load path: bear on post, hollow shell, fixity cases)

fixed.description: post bottom bolted/screwed to the deck or to a base plate screwed to the deck
fixed.governing: whole-cart transverse tip (5.28 m/s2); post yield at 24.1 m/s2 is not governing

pinned_gap.description: post bottom captive (socket/hole/base plate with play) but free to rotate through a gap; shell + velcro take the moment after the gap closes
pinned_gap.governing: velcro/cradle tip accel divided by impact factor 2.0 (gap closure); the shell wall at the slot can also crush (hollow shell, local load ~m a h / R)

velcro_only.description: post bottom reaches nothing (sketch 'gap'); bear+post hang on the shell via the slot and feet velcro; shell held by bottom velcro on the cradle
velcro_only.governing: rigid stack about the cradle contact edge b=0.12 m, h_cm=0.80 m; velcro peel would raise it to 2.15 m/s2 but velcro fatigues under 2 Hz cyclic peel -> no credit; feet-velcro peel lets the bear+post fall THROUGH the gap

modes.name: bear_on_post_sway_FIXED_base
modes.basis: post bottom bolted to deck/base plate: steel square tube 22 mm x 1.2 mm wall (EI=1445 N m2) cantilever to bear CoM L=1.01 m, m_eff=bear+0.24 post, x0.5-1.0 for the wing-nut telescoping joint, gravity softening -g/L. PHOTO v2

modes.name: bear_on_post_sway_PINNED_gap
modes.basis: post bottom captive but free to rotate through the gap; restoring stiffness only from the hollow shell at the slot edge + feet velcro, k=1-8 kN/m at r=ball diameter, minus m g h of bear+post. Amplitude-dependent: inside the gap the stiffness is ZERO and the post hits the slot edge (impact). PHOTO v2 + sketch 'gap'

modes.name: stack_rocking_VELCRO_only
modes.basis: bear+post+shell as one rigid body on the ball-bottom velcro/cradle springs, k=2-15 kN/m at r=0.12 m minus m g h_cm; k_th<=0 (statically unstable, only velcro peel holds it) for the soft case -> floored at 0.3 Hz. PHOTO v2 sketch 'velcro' at ball bottom

modes.name: post_in_slot_rattle_impact
modes.basis: post hits the slot edge across 1-4 mm clearance; hollow shell local stiffness 3-20 kN/m vs ~3 kg effective post+bear mass at the slot -> 6-25 Hz, strongly nonlinear (impact, chatter), excited by every start/stop and by cart pitch. SEEN slot clearance

modes.name: ball_shell_ovalling_seam
modes.basis: thin hollow sphere ~0.47 m, two halves screwed at a seam: ovalling/seam-flap modes 15-60 Hz (ASSUMED wall 2-5 mm plastic/paper-mache); excited by 250 Hz step buzz subharmonics and by the post rattle; drums (noise), fatigue at the screw holes

modes.name: cart_bounce_vertical
modes.basis: 6 contacts, caster PU + carpet/pad in series 15-40 kN/m each; m = whole cart v2 (29-54 kg)

modes.name: cart_horizontal_on_carpet
modes.basis: tyre sidewall + carpet pile shear 5-25 kN/m per contact, 6 contacts; stick-slip

modes.name: drivetrain_loaded_stepper_spring
modes.basis: rotor + cart mass (via r^2/G^2) on the stepper's magnetic spring k=T_h*50 (T_h=0.21 Nm at 1.25 A)

modes.name: stepper_rotor_midband_resonance
modes.basis: rotor alone: f=(1/2pi)sqrt(k_m/J_rot); classic full-step resonance 100-300 Hz

modes.name: arm_cantilever_hollow_frame
modes.basis: light hollow arm (~0.3 kg eff.) on a thin rod/plastic shoulder joint, 0.45 m; one arm raised, one horizontal (SEEN) -> asymmetric, lateral CoM offset ~2-4 cm

modes.name: head_on_neck
modes.basis: ~1 kg head + jaw motor on a short neck joint, k 0.3-2.5 kN/m (ASSUMED)

modes.name: torso_on_dance_pivot
modes.basis: torso ~2-3 kg at ~0.3 m above the hip pivot restrained by the dance gear train; backlash rattles (ASSUMED mechanism)

modes.name: caster_swivel_kinematic_trail
modes.basis: f=V/(2 pi e), V=0.0455 m/s, e=3-5 cm; swivel friction ~overdamped

modes.name: caster_swivel_rattle_play
modes.basis: swivel bearing + axle play with lateral tyre stiffness, excited at reversals and by the 250 Hz buzz

modes.name: cart_pitch_load_transfer
modes.basis: cart pitching on the contact springs when the jerk shifts dN=m a h/L

excitations.name: segment_pattern_fundamental
excitations.note: 0.8 s on / 1 s pause / 0.8 s reverse / 1 s pause; velocity-step impulses -> flat comb to >10 Hz without a ramp

excitations.name: start_stop_jerk
excitations.note: commanded: full speed in one 4 ms step; real: torque/traction-limited (mid masses v2)

excitations.name: full_step_rate
excitations.note: 1.8 deg/step; torque ripple; buzz; drums the hollow shell

excitations.name: stepper_midband_overlap
excitations.note: 250 steps/s inside the rotor's 170-330 Hz resonance band

excitations.name: gearbox_mesh
excitations.note: planetary ring teeth x output speed (ASSUMED tooth counts)

excitations.name: reversal_backlash_impact
excitations.note: 2 reversals per 3.6 s cycle; gearbox/hub backlash impacts AND post-in-slot impacts (v2)

excitations.name: post_slot_gap_closure
excitations.note: NEW v2: every start/stop first moves the cart through the slot clearance (1-4 mm across, ~10 cm along!) before the shell can push the post -> impact; along the slot the shell gives NO restraint at all, only the feet velcro

excitations.name: caster_flip_at_reversal
excitations.note: casters never finish the 180 deg swing in a 0.1-3.4 cm segment -> scrub: ~38 N per caster, up to 1.8 m/s2 lateral kick

excitations.name: try_me_dance_torso_sway
excitations.note: 'torso moves side-to-side', 20 s cycle (MEASURED); sits in the sway band; with a pinned/velcro post bottom the dance itself rocks the stack

forbidden_bands_note: 0.3-6 Hz: bear-on-post sway (all fixities), stack rocking on velcro, torso pivot, arms -> no un-ramped periodic start/stop; ramp >= 1 s
6-30 Hz: post-in-slot rattle, cart bounce/pitch, gear mesh, loaded drivetrain ring -> rise times < 80 ms excite the slot impact
150-330 Hz: stepper rotor mid-band; 250 full steps/s is INSIDE; also drums the hollow shell
cog_height_note: bear+post+shell stack CoM above the deck (mid, v2 photo geometry); whole cart CoM above floor = 0.37 m
base_halfwidth_note: ball-on-cradle contact half-width (velcro_only / pinned_gap); fixed case has no rigid-body tip

recommended_profile.note: keep every start/stop acceleration below 1/3 of the worst-case fixity tip accel; FIX THE POST BOTTOM FIRST (fixed case) and shim the slot
